name: Robin Healthcare
one_liner: AI medical scribe with dedicated hardware device for ambient documentation
short_description: Robin Healthcare combines ambient AI scribe technology with a dedicated hardware device (Robin Assistant) to automate clinical documentation. The platform saves physicians an average of 90 minutes...
long_description:
Robin Healthcare is an AI-powered medical scribe solution that distinguishes itself through a combination of ambient AI technology and a dedicated hardware device called the Robin Assistant. The physical device sits in the exam room and captures the patient-physician conversation, generating structured clinical notes automatically.

The Robin Assistant device is designed to integrate naturally into the clinical workflow without requiring physicians to interact with smartphones or wearables. The system captures ambient audio, processes it through Robin's AI engine, and delivers draft notes for physician review. The company reports that physicians save an average of 90 minutes per day on documentation tasks.

Robin Healthcare has raised over $82 million in funding and reports high satisfaction metrics, including 98% patient acceptance of the technology in exam rooms. The platform integrates with major EHR systems and supports various specialties in ambulatory care settings.

The hardware-based approach may appeal to practices seeking a dedicated documentation solution that doesn't rely on mobile devices or computer microphones. However, this approach also means higher implementation complexity compared to software-only AI scribes. Robin is best suited for established practices and health systems ready to invest in dedicated infrastructure for AI documentation.

faqs.q: What is the Robin Assistant device?
faqs.a: The Robin Assistant is a dedicated hardware device that sits in exam rooms to capture patient-physician conversations. Unlike software-only AI scribes that use phone or computer microphones, Robin uses purpose-built hardware for ambient documentation.

faqs.q: How much time does Robin Healthcare save?
faqs.a: Robin Healthcare reports that physicians save an average of 90 minutes per day on documentation tasks using the ambient AI scribe system.

faqs.q: Do patients accept the Robin device in exam rooms?
faqs.a: Robin Healthcare reports 98% patient acceptance rates for the Robin Assistant device in clinical settings.

faqs.q: What EHRs does Robin integrate with?
faqs.a: Robin Healthcare integrates with major EHR systems including Epic, Cerner, and athenahealth, automatically populating notes into patient charts.
